title: Local reviewer-adapter output (caller-owned, not a product contract)
description: What this application would accept back from a reviewer adapter. category, blockers and skipped_reason reuse the SDK's published closed vocabularies (doublegate_sdk.reasons, .vocabulary, .skipped) so a value that passes here also passes the SDK normalisers. No field here admits, promotes or withdraws anything; a gate never sees this document, and no gate validates it.
